svg.title: Скручивания в тренажёре сидя — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Seated abdominal crunch on a dedicated selectorized abdominal crunch machine. Side-three-quarter view, feet firmly on low foot supports, hips firmly seated in both phases. Show a single high hinged padded lever with handles by shoulders, padded upper-torso contact, and machine weight stack. Left upright with spine neutral and hands holding lever handles at shoulders. Right same seated pelvis, torso curls forward toward thighs, elbows stay close to chest, visibly rotating the lever forward around its fixed pivot. Arms do not pull independently and no cable handle, no back-extension posture. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
